Steps.use: progress across an ordered sequence of stages

rules.steps: Give every step a label; description is optional supporting text.
rules.status: Give a step its own status to override the derived one, otherwise Steps derives complete/current/upcoming from current, the zero-based index of the active step.
rules.ownership: Steps only displays the sequence; the caller owns which step is current and any navigation between them.
rules.static: A sequence with no progress state, just numbered instructions, is a ProcessList instead.

Steps.explicit: <Steps steps={[{ label: "Cuenta", status: "complete" }, { label: "Envío", status: "current" }, { label: "Pago", status: "upcoming" }]} />
